Package com.longbridge.asset

Enum RewardDeliverStatus

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<RewardDeliverStatus>
      • com.longbridge.asset.RewardDeliverStatus
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<RewardDeliverStatus>
    public enum RewardDeliverStatus
extends Enum<RewardDeliverStatus>
    Delivery status of an issued prize

    The Java ordinal is not the server code: use code() to get the code the server uses for a constant, and fromCode(int) for the reverse.
